# Additional graduate program costs

Checked 17 October 2026. The accompanying JSON supplies **all 11 graduate career IDs** that previously fell back to `genericGraduate`. Every record names a Texas public university program that actually prepares for the selected career or credential. No production files changed.

## Coverage and useful amounts

| Career ID | Program example | Numerical benchmark | Preparation scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| speech-language | Texas State MS Communication Disorders, Round Rock | Fall 2026 resident graduate 9-credit semester: $4,511.49 | 63 credits non-thesis; prerequisites and clinical training matter |
| school-psychology | Texas State Specialist in School Psychology | Same published semester benchmark | 69 credits, three years, practicum and internship |
| statistics | Texas State MS Mathematics, Statistics concentration | Same published semester benchmark | 36 credits non-thesis or 30 thesis |
| mental-health-counselor | Texas State MA Professional Counseling, Clinical Mental Health | Same published semester benchmark | 60 credits; degree precedes additional LPC supervision |
| school-counselor | Texas State MA Professional Counseling, School Counseling | Same published semester benchmark | Selected 60-credit certification concentration |
| urban-planning | UT Austin MS Community and Regional Planning | $6,239 resident 12-credit semester; four such terms calculate to $24,956 | 48 credits; calculated tuition scenario, living extra |

| librarian | UNT MS Library Science | Advertised estimated resident tuition/fees $16,500 | 36-credit ALA-accredited degree; living extra |

## Evidence and implementation decisions

### Texas State routes

[Fall 2026 graduate tuition rates](https://onestop.txst.edu/cost-payments/cost-attendance/tuition-rates.html) price nine resident credits at $4,511.49 and nine nonresident credits at $8,364.49. The [2026–27 graduate attendance budget](https://onestop.txst.edu/cost-payments/cost-attendance/graduate-coa.html) has $9,020 rounded fall/spring tuition and $27,660 total for nine credits each term, living on/off campus. That allowance is not a program total. Credit load and campus can change fees, so do not multiply it by program years as an official price.

The records pair the actual institutional rate with verified programs: [speech-language pathology](https://www.health.txst.edu/cdis/graduate-degree-program.html), [school psychology](https://www.gradcollege.txst.edu/programs/ssp.html), [statistics concentration](https://www.gradcollege.txst.edu/programs/math.html), [clinical mental health/school counseling](https://www.gradcollege.txst.edu/programs/counseling.html). Professional counseling has its own [additional expenses](https://www.txst.edu/clas/coun/current-students/anticipated-program-costs.html), including liability coverage and licensure/exams. None is renamed “generic graduate study.”

For full-route calculations use actual planned semester credits, the institution's fee schedule, and study months. Keep a calculated program budget distinct from an institution-published total. The JSON preserves degree credits and marks any suggested planning duration explicitly as a scenario. The [speech-language course sequence](https://docs.gato.txst.edu/786571/Grad%20Course%20Sequence%202024_Accessibility.pdf) spans two academic years with summer study; thesis and leveling can add time. School psychology's [2025 handbook](https://docs.gato.txst.edu/743349/Program%20Handbook_Rev%20Aug_21_2025.pdf) explicitly describes a three-year route.

### Named published or derived degree totals

[UT Economics](https://ma.eco.utexas.edu/tuition/) publishes separate Option III prices: $36,000 resident for 10 months, $43,500 for 18 months and $54,600 for 24 months. Use these, not ordinary graduate tuition. Books/living and some ancillary charges are excluded. The university's [2026–27 tuition tables](https://catalog.utexas.edu/general-information/registration-tuition-and-fees/tuition-and-fees/tables-tuition-for-fall-and-spring/) independently list these program amounts and price Architecture graduate study used for the [48-credit planning master's](https://soa.utexas.edu/planning/masters).

[UNT's official online program page](https://online.unt.edu/programs/graduate/library-science) estimates $16.5K for the 36-credit, ALA-accredited Library Science MS. The price is rounded and lacks an academic-year label; preserve that source status internally. Library science preparation is distinct from Texas school-librarian educator certification.

[UTHealth's MPH Epidemiology](https://sph.uth.edu/academic-programs/masters-programs/epidemiology) is 45 credits with 18–24-month full-time completion. Its [2026–27 public-health fee table](https://www.uth.edu/bursars/student-resources/tuition-fees/school-of-public-health) gives resident tuition $287/credit plus $85/credit technology fee. Computed degree subtotals are $12,915 and $3,825. Required institution and term fees remain separate. A credited $200 enrollment deposit must not be added twice.

[UTA's AG primary-care NP MSN](https://academicpartnerships.uta.edu/healthcare-nursing-online-programs/msn-adult-gerontology/primary-care-nurse-practitioner/) publishes $26,814 tuition, 41 credits, 29–33 months, and BSN/active RN prerequisites. It states certification eligibility followed by Texas APRN recognition. This is a qualifying NP example, with a specific population focus; graduate tuition does not price the prerequisite nursing degree.

[UTSW's coordinated dietetics master's](https://shp.utsouthwestern.edu/programs/clinical-nutrition-coordinated-program/) is a 24-month post-baccalaureate program preparing registered dietitians. The [2026–27 COA](https://www.utsw.edu/education/students/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance/health-professions/) gives resident program portions $45,756, $54,067 and final partial-year $13,034. Their sum is $112,857; tuition/fee portions sum to $23,666. These are current-year budgets across portions, not a guaranteed future cohort price. The older undated program marketing estimate is lower; the JSON deliberately favors dated financial-aid budgets.

## Route mistakes caught during research

- **UT Austin MS Statistics is not offered as a standalone program.** Its [official page](https://stat.utexas.edu/academics/master-science-statistics) limits it to current UT doctoral students concurrently earning the MS. Use the verified Texas State statistics concentration here.
- **A generic online nutrition master's is not the whole RDN route.** The selected UTSW program is coordinated and includes practice preparation.
- **Texas school counselors no longer need two prior classroom teaching years as a universal certification rule.** [TEA's adopted amendment](https://tea.texas.gov/about-tea/laws-and-rules/sbec-rules-tac/sbec-adopted/24-04-239-20.pdf) removes that requirement. District hiring preferences and school-librarian requirements are separate.
- **NP is a graduate specialization after nursing preparation.** Never show the master's tuition alone as the cost from high school to NP.

## Integration notes

The JSON's top-level keys are the 11 career IDs; values conform to the existing `educationCostEvidence` shape. Additional `programCredits`, `duration`, `qualificationEvidence` and `additionalSourceURLs` make route budgeting reproducible. `amounts` keeps published semester, annual attendance and calculated whole-program subtotals separate. Feature the amount whose scope is visible in the headline; do not call a semester amount “the degree cost.”

Do not invent future fees, automatic assistantships, guaranteed scholarships or loan eligibility. Populate a calculation from these current named benchmarks and the student's selected route; store evidence detail in Developer while keeping student prompts short.
